Shares DeleteStack's physical body: null returns false; otherwise calls free and returns true. This fold is not a no-op and does not justify removing deallocation. Existing accepted-alias evidence establishes list and stack consumers.

Cosmic Forge directly labels record +0x181 Experience. Retail GetMonsterExperience prefers nonzero +0x26b over that base; MonsterInfoDialog displays the effective value after the species reaches the post-combat known state, while the other canonical consumer uses it as an HP-weighted combat-difficulty proxy. Names are descriptive; no original Sir-Tech identifier is claimed.
